description: The modern App Router baseline where fetch() calls, ORM queries, and GET Route Handlers execute dynamically per request unless explicitly opted into caching.
The next.config.ts setting (formerly experimental dynamicIO) that unifies Partial Prerendering and function-level caching, requiring all async I/O to use either 'use cache' or a <Suspense> boundary.
The client-side cache duration for visited route segments, which defaults to 0 seconds for page segments so back/forward and link navigations reflect fresh server state.
The build and runtime check under cacheComponents that throws an error if uncached asynchronous I/O is awaited outside a <Suspense> fallback boundary.
